train_model: run the detectron model training loop with checkpointing and loss monitoring
create_model: build a detectron model and auto-resume from the latest checkpoint if available
optimize_memory: optimize GPU memory by sharing gradient blobs across devices using memonger
setup_model_for_training: setup a detectron model for training by loading weights and starting the data loader
dump_proto_files: dump the training network and parameter initialization network prototxt files to disk
